name: cubby-ui
description: Framework-agnostic UI components with pure HTML + Tailwind CSS

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/core && tailwindcss -i ./src/styles/lib.css -o ./dist/core/cubby-ui.css && tailwindcss -i ./src/styles/lib.css -o ./dist/core/cubby-ui.min.css --minify && cp ./src/scripts/cubby-ui.js ./dist/core/cubby-ui.js && cp ./src/scripts/cubby-ui.d.ts ./dist/core/cubby-ui.d.ts && cp ./components.json ./dist/components.json && terser ./dist/core/cubby-ui.js -o ./dist/core/cubby-ui.min.js -c -m --source-map
scripts.build:blade: node scripts/generate-blade-components.cjs && cp stubs/laravel/CubbyUiServiceProvider.php stubs/laravel/README.md dist/laravel/
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:blade && npm run build:docs

author: Denny Kuo
